SELECT RAWTOHEX(R.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_ID,
       R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
       R.STATUS,
       R.REQUEST_DATE,
       RAWTOHEX(M.MERCHANT_ID) AS MERCHANT_ID,
       M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
       M.CIF,
       M.BRANCH_CODE,
       M.RM_NAME,

       COUNT(CASE WHEN p.POS = 'POS' THEN 1 END) AS POS_COUNT,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN p.POS = 'POC' THEN 1 END) AS POC_COUNT,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN p.POS = 'UPG' THEN 1 END) AS UPG_COUNT

FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST R

JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT M
    ON M.MERCHANT_ID = R.MERCHANT_ID
   AND M.IS_DELETED = 0

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL T
    ON T.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID
   AND T.IS_DELETED = 0

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_POS P
    ON P.POS_ID = T.POS_ID

WHERE R.IS_DELETED = 0 --and r.CONTRACT_SERIAL = 'BDC5APR1002-1'

GROUP BY R.REQUEST_ID,
         R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
         R.STATUS,
         R.REQUEST_DATE,
         M.MERCHANT_ID,
         M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
         M.CIF,
         M.BRANCH_CODE,
         M.RM_NAME

ORDER BY R.REQUEST_DATE DESC
